theorems.name: Submission.slicing_mb_cutoff
theorems.statement: ∀ (t h ε : ℝ), 0 < h → 0 < ε → ∃ χ : ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) χ ∧ (∀ s, 0 ≤ χ s ∧ χ s ≤ 1) ∧ (∀ s, s ≤ t - h → χ s = 1) ∧ (∀ s, t ≤ s → χ s = 0) ∧ (∀ s, |deriv χ s| ≤ (1 + ε) / h) ∧ (∀ s, s ∉ Ioo (t - h) t → deriv χ s = 0)
